A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the CNT oscillator encapsulating the platinum nanocluster has the potential to be a nano oscillator with a wide frequency range and the frequency can be tuned by the size of the platinum nanoclusters.
the oscillation of a platinum nanoclusters in a carbon nanotube is not regular and the frequency of oscillation depends strongly on the temperature and cluster size.
the CNT oscillators encapsulating the platinum nanocluster have the potential to be applied as nanoelectromechanical systems (NEMS).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CNT oscillator is a good candidate for the study of nanomechanics.

the oscillating frequency of a CNT oscillator encapsulating a nanocluster is not a constant but varies with the temperature and the size of the nanocluster, providing a new insight into the study of nano oscillators.
the CNT oscillator can be used as a temperature sensor and the oscillation of platinum cluster can be used as an effective method to measure the size of the nanocluster.
